name: polystore
description: A small compatibility layer for many popular KV stores like localStorage, Redis, FileSystem, etc.
author: Francisco Presencia <public@francisco.io> (https://francisco.io/)

scripts.build: npm run build:bundle && npm run build:types && npm run build:prettier
scripts.build:bundle: bunx tsup src/index.ts --format esm --minify --sourcemap --out-dir . --target node24 && bunx tsup src/plugins/express/index.ts --format esm --out-dir src/plugins/express --target node24 --external polystore --external express-session && bunx tsup src/plugins/hono-sessions/index.ts --format esm --out-dir src/plugins/hono-sessions --target node24 --external polystore --external hono-sessions && bunx tsup src/plugins/better-auth/index.ts --format esm --out-dir src/plugins/better-auth --target node24 --external polystore && bunx tsup src/plugins/axios-cache-interceptor/index.ts --format esm --out-dir src/plugins/axios-cache-interceptor --target node24 --external polystore --external axios-cache-interceptor
scripts.build:types: dts-bundle-generator --out-file index.d.ts --export-referenced-types false src/index.ts && tsc --ignoreConfig --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --skipLibCheck --types bun --rootDir src/plugins --outDir src/plugins src/plugins/*/index.ts
scripts.services: concurrently "npm run service:db" "npm run service:redis" "npm run service:postgres" "npm run service:server"

documentation.page.title: 🏬 Polystore - A universal library for standardizing any KV-store
